summary: Faster colour-negative and print model with stronger grain, a warm print bias and mild highlight halation. The 400 in the name is a speed-class label, not a measured ISO speed.
constants_origin: Round illustrative parameters chosen for this project, then gray-balanced inside this same model. Not fitted to a scan, not copied from a manufacturer table, and not taken from another film-simulation project.
notes: Illustrative parameters only. Physical resemblance to any real film is unverified.
